overview_description.description: Sprig is the product development lifecycle research platform with a mission to make experiences that matter. Companies use Sprig’s Concept and Usability Testing and In-Product Surveys to get research insights from users about new ideas, designs, and prototypes, as well as currently available product experiences. Dropbox, Square, Opendoor, and Loom trust Sprig to help them build better products.

about_short_description.short_description: Sprig is an online platform that provides in-product surveys and usability test power research services with cutting-edge technology.

product.name: In-Product Surveys
product.description: Surveys delivered within digital products to collect feedback in the context of users’ real interactions and journeys.

product.name: Long-Form Surveys
product.description: A survey tool for conducting detailed foundational research with advanced question types, logic, randomization, and distribution options.

product.name: AI Insights
product.description: AI-assisted analysis that synthesizes survey responses and behavioral data into themes, patterns, trends, and product insights.

product.name: Replays
product.description: Session recordings that let teams observe real user interactions to identify friction, behaviors, and usability issues.

product.name: Feedback
product.description: An always-on feedback collection tool for gathering open-ended user input across different stages of the product journey.

product.name: Heatmaps
product.description: Visualizations of user clicks and scrolling behavior that reveal engagement patterns and areas of interaction within digital products.
